    Records, filters, selections, drafts, caches, searches and open tabs.

  3. Load only ORG-SAMPLE-B

    Name shown prominently; never mixed data on one screen.

Security

Security & settings

SEC-001 encryption posture — a design proposal. No encryption is implemented or claimed in this concept.

Design proposal only

The values below describe intended posture for Architect and Sam review. Nothing here encrypts, stores or protects real data.

Proposal

SEC-001 encryption posture

Proposed controls · none implemented
ControlProposalStatus
Encryption in transitTLS 1.2+ for all trafficProposed
Encryption at restDatabase & file storage encrypted with managed keysProposed
Field-level encryptionUSI, DOB, passport, wellbeing notes — per-RTO keysProposed · SEC-001
Key managementManaged KMS, rotation every 12 months, access auditedProposed
BackupsEncrypted, region-locked, restore tested quarterlyProposed

Authentication policy

MFA for platform staff
Required (proposed)
Session timeout
30 min idle (proposed)
Password policy
Passphrase ≥ 14 chars (proposed)

Intentionally omitted

No break-glass / elevation UI

SEC-002 (emergency access and privilege elevation) is pending. No elevation, impersonation or break-glass controls are designed or shown anywhere in this prototype.
